Powerful deities and warlords strive for dominance over the [Plane of Fire](/Planes.aspx?ID=6) and the rest of the Inner Sphere in order to prove fire's supremacy. Armies of flaming soldiers go to war against each other on battlefields of smoke and smoldering char, all unable to bring their full power to bear. [Ymeri](/Deities.aspx?ID=108), the vicious and victorious Queen of the Inferno, commands legions of sootsoldiers: elementals capable of battling the armies of her foes and, even when destroyed, rising from the ashes of the Eternal Furnace, scorched and triumphant. **[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 27 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 25 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 22 [Sootsoldiers](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2639) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 133 **Perception** +20; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), smoke vision **Languages** [Pyric](/Languages.aspx?ID=110) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +21, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +21, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +18, [Plane of Fire Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +18, [Warfare Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +18 **Str** +7 **Dex** +5 **Con** +6 **Int** +2 **Wis** +4 **Cha** +0 **Smoke Vision** Sootsoldiers ignore the [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) condition from smoke. --- **AC** 30 **Fort** +20 **Ref** +21 **Will** +18 **HP** 165 (16 squares) **Immunities** bleed, [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145) **Weaknesses** area damage 12, [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27) 12, [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=150) damage 7 **Ashen Smoke** When the sootsoldiers are reduced by an HP Threshold or are reduced to 0 HP, the destroyed soldiers crumble to a cloud of ash-laden smoke in 20-foot burst centered on the sootsoldiers. All creatures within the cloud are [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4), and all creatures outside it are concealed to those inside. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind.
**[Troop Defenses](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=44)** --- **Speed** 40 feet; troop movement **[Form Up](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=43)** **Incinerating Grasp** **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** The sootsoldiers reach to constrain each enemy within 5 feet in their fiery clutches (DC 26 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). The damage and additional effects depend on the number of actions.
2d8 fire damage
3d8+7 fire damage plus [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20)
4d8+7 fire damage plus grabbed **Seething Flash** ([Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) The sootsoldiers reignite and rush across the battlefield, Forming Up and Striding twice. At the end of this movement, a wave of flame and heat pours off the sootsoldiers, dealing 4d8 fire damage to other creatures in a 10-foot emanation, with a DC 29 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. A creature that critically fails its save is also knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31). **Troop Movement** Whenever the sootsoldiers Stride, they first Form Up as a free action to condense into a 20-foot-by-20-foot area (minus any missing squares), then move up to their Speed. This works just like a Gargantuan creature moving; for instance, if any of the sootsoldiers' squares enters difficult terrain, the extra movement cost applies to the whole troop
The Radiant Host Sootsoldiers who serve the other Lord of Fire, the Lambent King [Atreia](/Deities.aspx?ID=101), are covered in glowing embers instead of black char. In place of ashen smoke's normal effects, any creature in the area must attempt a DC 29 Reflex save. On a failure, for 1 minute that creature is [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) and its invisibility is negated.
